meta.description: Card Anatomy Database — Layout structures, section zones, and component slots for Rubii Card Architect v2.2.7+
meta.usage: Reference 'layout_id' in prompts to request a specific card structure.

zones.hero_zone: Full-bleed character image or gradient portrait background

zones.header_zone: Case ID stamp, classification level badge, red 'CLASSIFIED' overlay
zones.data_zone: Key-value pairs: DOB, Status, Threat Level, Affiliation
zones.redaction_zone: Black redaction bar over sensitive fields

zones.illustration_zone: Central large illustration or character portrait
zones.title_zone: Card name in ornate serif (bottom or top banner)
zones.symbolism_zone: Small icons / astrology symbols in corners
zones.border_zone: Ornate illustrated border with theme-specific motifs

zones.status_bar: HP/MP/Status bars at top in HUD style
zones.portrait_zone: Corner portrait thumbnail with glow border
zones.info_panel: Character name, level, class in monospace font
zones.skill_zone: Grid of 4–6 skill icons with hotkey labels
zones.log_zone: Scrolling battle log or dialogue text area

zones.orbit_zone: 2–4 NPC thumbnails orbiting in relation web
zones.connection_lines: CSS border lines or flex spacers showing relationships
zones.label_zone: Relationship type labels: Rival, Ally, Love, Nemesis

zones.timeline_spine: Vertical or horizontal line as the timeline axis
zones.event_nodes: Circular or diamond markers at each event
zones.event_cards: Small cards branching from each node with date + description
zones.era_dividers: Bold section headers for major eras / arcs
zones.final_node: Present-day status indicator at timeline end

zones.masthead_zone: Publication name / zine title at top
zones.cover_story_zone: Main headline over or beside portrait
zones.sidebar_teasers: 3–4 short text blurbs with divider lines
zones.portrait_zone: Large character portrait, bleed to edges
zones.barcode_zone: Fake barcode or issue stamp at bottom corner

zones.effect_text_zone: Ability description in game-style flavor text box
zones.power_zone: ATK / DEF or equivalent stat numbers at bottom corners

zones.scene_background: Full-bleed scene illustration or gradient backdrop
zones.character_sprite_zone: Standing character sprite, centered or left/right offset
zones.dialogue_box: Semi-transparent box at bottom with dialogue text
zones.speaker_nameplate: Character name badge above dialogue box
zones.choice_buttons: 2–4 CSS radio choice buttons at bottom

zones.canopy_zone: Decorative arch or celestial halo at top
zones.offering_zone: Small icon row: flowers, candles, crystals
zones.prayer_text_zone: Italic text block styled as a prayer or oath
zones.seal_zone: Sacred emblem or family crest at bottom center
